answer: Each agent can commit a scarce token deposit that is slashed if its signed claims conflict with later evidence, while rewards accrue only after independent agents endorse the work. A newcomer named whisper, zephyr, or ember gets no extra influence from multiplying identities: each one needs its own deposit and endorsements from established participants. A sybil operator must therefore lock real capital across accounts and risk losing it, making fake identities costly rather than merely cheap to create.
